overviewParagraphs: Cascata Golf Club takes a refreshingly playful approach to course design in a Bangkok market that can sometimes takes itself too seriously — delivering 36 holes of inventive, entertaining golf that manages to be genuinely challenging while also being undeniably fun. The hallmark features are the unusually large, multi-tiered greens and the creative bunkering arrangements that require golfers to think laterally about approach shots and putting.

Water plays a persistent strategic role across both layouts, with fountains, lakes, and streams appearing in locations that demand respect without being unnecessarily punishing. The overall tone is of a course designed to generate excellent memories and good scoring challenges rather than to intimidate or frustrate — a genuine strength for group golf.

AGS recommends Cascata for Bangkok programs that include mixed ability groups, corporate golf events, or societies looking for a Bangkok round that prioritises shared enjoyment over pure championship challenge. The 36-hole capacity also makes it excellent for full-day group programs without course congestion.

curatorBriefHtml: Cascata Golf Club (opened 2006 in Nakhon Nayok, roughly 60–70 minutes northeast of central Bangkok) is one of Thailand’s most inventive and fun 36-hole designs — split into four distinct 9-hole loops (A, B, C, and D; 6,630 yards Blue Tees, Par 72). Designed by Dr. Thanawat Saprungruang, Cascata mixes links-inspired mounding on its newer C and D loops with bold water-framed parkland holes and huge, multi-tiered greens.

Because Cascata sits just beyond Bangkok’s busy inner beltway, it offers relaxed pace of play, creative shotmaking, and standout value compared to Bangkok’s ultra-expensive private clubs — particularly popular with returning groups who want a lively, memorable match-play venue where risk-reward holes swing matches fast.

AGS recommends requesting the C and D loops (featuring Cascata’s signature Scottish-links mounding and dramatic island par 3s), pairing Cascata with Alpine Golf Club or Thai Country Club on a 4-round Bangkok golf week.

scorecard.verdict: A 36-hole green oasis designed like a private botanical sanctuary. Course D features links-style hummocks and expansive waste bunkers that challenge approach accuracy.

faqs.q: Which of Cascata's four 9-hole loops should visiting groups request?
faqs.a: Courses C and D are the standouts — showcasing bold links-style mounding, inventive waste bunkers, island-style par 3s, and huge contoured greens that make group match play unforgettable.

faqs.q: How far is Cascata Golf Club from central Bangkok?
faqs.a: Allow 60 to 75 minutes northeast of central Bangkok by private touring vehicle, departing around 07:00 AM to cruise out smoothly.

faqs.q: Is Cascata Golf Club suitable for mixed-handicap groups?
faqs.a: Yes — wide tee landing zones let higher handicappers stay in play, while multi-tiered greens and abundant water hazards keep low-handicappers fully engaged.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Cascata?
faqs.a: November through February offers Bangkok’s coolest, driest playing weather; early morning starts work well year-round.
